Call for Applications: Data 4 Early Warning Hackathon 2025
Saturday, 12 July 2025 08:00Thursday, 17 July 2025 16:00

Are you passionate about using tech and data for impact? Join us in building GNSS-powered solutions to improve Early Warning Systems in Africa.

Open to developers, data analysts, and policy thinkers.

Virtual Hackathon: 20th of May – 12th of July 2025. Winners will be announced at the High-Level Pre-Event of the Africa Satellite Navigation Conference planned for 16th - 17 July 2025 in Cabo Verde.

Choose your track:

  • GeoStory Analytics – Create dashboards and storymaps using GNSS data
  • Policy Memo – Propose bold, data-driven early warning policies

Apply by the 10th of June 2025

To apply, please click on this application form: https://forms.gle/Ni1XpLRSGNSsds2B7

For any other queries, use the following email contact: event@satnav-africa.com

Looking forward to your respective participation to this event!

For more details, please invit the event website by clicking here.
